summary: The images take B12X from FlashInfer 0.7.1, which ships it as flashinfer/experimental/b12x; there is no separate b12x wheel any more
compatibility: Code that imports b12x keeps working: the FlashInfer wheel installs the same b12x package. Do not install a standalone b12x wheel into the image; it would replace FlashInfer's.
details: The beta is rebuilt on canonical: vLLM integration/karmic-kraken-beta is dev/karmic-kraken plus the GLM-5.3 (744B) work still in review and the hybrid A4 prefill; FlashInfer integration/karmic-kraken-beta is LIL main plus the hybrid A4 prefill.
The canonical image waits until canonical vLLM requires FlashInfer 0.7.1; its publication is paused until then.

FlashInfer 0.7.1 brings nccl4py 0.4.1, nccl-extensions 0.1.0 and nvidia-cudnn-frontend 1.30.0, and splits the JIT cache into the flashinfer-jit-cache shim and the flashinfer-jit-cache-sm120f provider.
NVFP4-CSF checkpoints load through ModelOpt recipes (--quantization modelopt_mixed --load-format instanttensor), including the GLM-5.3 (744B) container checkpoint, without a Hub change.
